name: Microsoft Copilot & Microsoft 365
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio and agents, the consumer Copilot app, Copilot in Windows and Edge, and Copilot+ PCs.

items.title: Edge 157 upgrades the Copilot new tab page and Copilot experience
items.summary: Edge 157 adds an upgraded Copilot new tab page that brings search, chat, and web exploration together, with suggested actions and curated work content. Microsoft also updated the Copilot entry points and side pane, including upgraded Copilot Voice and Vision functionality.

items.title: Microsoft announces fair-use limits for additional Copilot Chat features
items.summary: Microsoft is introducing fair-use limits for additional Copilot Chat features for unlicensed users in commercial tenants, across web, desktop, and mobile. The change began November 2 for organizations with 2,000 or fewer Microsoft 365 seats and is scheduled to begin November 9 for larger organizations; Copilot Chat remains included with Microsoft 365 subscriptions, with no admin action required.

items.title: Microsoft brings GPT-5.6 and expanded Copilot app integration to government clouds
items.summary: Microsoft announced expanded Copilot capabilities for U.S. Government cloud customers, including GPT-5.6 in GCC, GCC-H, and DoD and editing with Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint across those environments. A simplified, chat-centered Copilot app design is available in GCC and GCC-H, with DoD availability to follow.

items.title: SharePoint tools in Work IQ enter public preview for agents
items.summary: Microsoft opened a public preview of more than 60 native SharePoint operations through Work IQ, allowing agents to find, understand, create, organize, and share SharePoint content. The tools are also rolling out to Copilot Studio, expanding the SharePoint work agents can perform.

items.title: Microsoft plans locked-down Copilot Chat mode for Study and Learn
items.summary: Microsoft is preparing an IT-controlled mode that locks Copilot Chat to the Study and Learn Agent, designed for educational settings. Students would not be able to switch to general Copilot Chat or other agents, while still being able to add their own files as references.

items.title: Estée Lauder expands Copilot access to more than 14,000 employees
items.summary: Estée Lauder expanded Microsoft Copilot access across its office-based global workforce of more than 14,000 people. The deployment is part of a broader effort to bring Microsoft AI and cloud tools into the company’s business operations.

items.title: Microsoft’s October Copilot roundup details product and admin updates
items.summary: Microsoft’s October Copilot roundup highlights updates across Cowork, SharePoint, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and administration. Among the changes are role-based Cowork plugins and a task catalog, a SharePoint knowledge base, Excel accounting skills, and Insights Agent capabilities for analyzing agent usage and feedback; some features are rolling out globally in November.

items.title: Microsoft expands Copilot with finance skills and partner-built plugins
items.summary: Microsoft announced more than 25 finance skills and partner-built plugins for accounting, capital markets, and other finance work. Accounting capabilities in Copilot in Excel and Cowork are available in Frontier, while the Capital Markets and Finance plugins for Cowork are generally available; Dynamics 365 ERP and partner plugins are beginning to roll out.

items.title: Copilot in SharePoint adds generally available image, analytics, and metadata tools
items.summary: Microsoft says advanced Copilot in SharePoint capabilities are now generally available, including image generation and editing, AI-generated site analytics reports, and near-real-time metadata autofill. The features use Copilot Credits and are available to Copilot-licensed users, adding new AI-assisted workflows across SharePoint sites and document libraries.

items.title: Microsoft details five new Copilot in Excel capabilities
items.summary: Microsoft’s October Excel update adds five Copilot capabilities, including tools to clean and retrieve data, create reusable skills, and work with an interactive canvas. Availability varies: some skills are rolling out generally, while the interactive canvas remains an Insider feature for Windows.

items.title: Microsoft expands Frontier previews to Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams
items.summary: Starting in November, Frontier will offer eligible public previews across Copilot, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams through one optional, admin-controlled enrollment program. This gives organizations a centralized way to test preview features and provide feedback; users still need licenses for the products they access.

items.title: Microsoft details mobilezone’s deployment of three Copilot Studio agents
items.summary: Microsoft reported that mobilezone built three Copilot Studio agents for store monitoring, sales order creation, and product creation. The store-monitoring agent helps a four-person IT support team query device information and investigate errors proactively, illustrating a live operational use of Copilot Studio agents.

items.title: Viva Glint previews Copilot Results Summarization for early November
items.summary: Microsoft announced a planned private preview of Results Summarization in Viva Glint Copilot Chat for early November. The experience brings survey scores and comment analysis together conversationally, with permissions and confidentiality safeguards continuing to apply.

items.title: Microsoft introduces the Power Platform Admin plugin for Copilot Cowork
items.summary: Microsoft introduced the Power Platform Admin plugin for Copilot Cowork, letting IT administrators ask natural-language questions grounded in tenant-specific Power Platform data. The post describes using those findings to produce audience-specific summaries and governance reports.
